And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To

Enquiry And Pass Award And There After Refer The
Matter For Entailment Of Compensation Amount For
An Extent Of 2 Acre In Sy.No. 211 Notified In The Name
Of Father Of Respondent No. 4 And Land Measuring 2
Acre In Sy.No. 45 Notified In The Name Of Petitioner As
Per The Annexure-G Situated At Obalapura Village,
Thyamagondlu Hobli, Nelamangala Taluk, Bangalore
Rural District Acquired By Him To The Competent Civil
Court, Authority Under The Land Acquisition Act And
Etc.,
 This Petition Coming On For Preliminary Hearing
This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The short grievance of the Petitioner is as to non- referral of the dispute in question to the Reference court under section 73 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned AGA appears for 1st Respondent.
Notice to 4th Respondent is dispensed with.

Learned Sr. Panel Counsel on request appearing for the 2nd & 3rd Respondents having initially opposed the Petition, now graciously agrees that the case of Petitioner requires to be favourably considered since there are elements of dispute between himself & the 4th Respondent herein.
This is fair enough.

In view of the above, the 3rd Respondent is directed to refer the matter to the jurisdictional Court under Section 73 of the 2013 Act for due adjudication in accordance with law, without brooking any delay.
